pos = s.find("at", 1)

    s = s[:pos] + "@" + s[pos+2:]

start = 1
while True:
    n = s.find("dot", start)
    if n == -1 or n > len(s) - 4:
        break
    s = s[:n] + "." + s[n+3:]
    start = n + 1
